blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) arrested two suspects tagged in the shooting of a barangay captain and his wife in San Juan, Abra. “So cases were already filed against them, two counts of frustrated murder,” said PNP Public Information Office chief Col. Allen Rae Co in a press briefing on Tuesday. READ: Abra police official shot dead after allegedly killing accuser The victims were brought to a hospital and were reported to be in stable condition.
